title: Entropy variational inequality
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite nonempty set, and let $q,y:\iota\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $q(x)\ge 0$ for every $x$ and have uniform mean $1$. Then the uniform expectation of $q(x)y(x)$ minus the logarithm of the uniform expectation of $\exp(y(x))$ is at most the uniform expectation of $q(x)\log q(x)$.
